content: आयुष्मत् {%a.%} [आयुस् मतुप्] .²1 Alive, living. .²2 Long-lived; आयुष्मन्तं सुतं सूते <ls>Ms. 3. 263</ls>. (Generally used in dramas by elderly persons in addressing a nobly-born person; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} a charioteer addresses a prince as आयुष्मन्. A Brāhmaṇa is also so addressed in saluting; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ms. 2. 125</ls>; आयुष्मान् भव सौम्येति वाच्यो विप्रोऽभिवादने). .²3 Lasting; गायन्ति पृथगायुष्मन्निदं नो वक्तुमर्हसि <ls>Bhāg. 11. 22. 3</ls>. .²4 Old. {%m.%} .²1 The third of the 27 Yogas or divisions of the ecliptic. .²2 The Yoga star कृत्तिका; the third lunar mansion.
